docs.cv:
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Backend Engineer | Java and Kotlin | Kafka, PostgreSQL, REST APIs
[EMAIL] | [PHONE]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with professional experience building Java and Kotlin services since 2019, including Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Kafka event processing, automated testing and production on-call. Interested in moving into a Python-focused backend role, bringing experience in comparable backend languages. Python experience to date is scripting rather than production services.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Backend: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, REST API design, OpenAPI 3
Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Oracle
Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ
Testing: Testcontainers, Spring Cloud Contract
Containers and cloud: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS S3, AWS SQS
Additional: Python scripts for data fixes and small Jenkins helpers; Go learning project (OpenAPI-diff CLI)
Production: On-call incident response, service reliability

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Backend Engineer | Tejo Insurance Tech | 2022–Present
- Designed a versioned OpenAPI 3 REST API for insurance brokers; added partner rate limiting and Spring Cloud Contract tests. Onboarded 12 broker partners, handling around 400,000 quote requests per month.
- Resolved duplicate claim records caused by at-least-once Kafka delivery by implementing a transactional outbox and consumer idempotency keys; duplicate claims fell from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter.
- Built a Kotlin and Spring Boot internal service to render policy PDFs from templates, using AWS S3 and SQS; wrote the company’s first Kotlin service guidelines.
- Participate in an on-call rota, one week per month. Handled a major Kafka lag incident in March 2024; the incident write-up was praised.
- Run the backend guild meeting every two weeks, since 2024.

Software Developer | Viajar Online | 2019–2021
- Worked on booking and payments in a large Java application.
- Raised payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70% using Testcontainers, enabling safer refactoring.
- Extracted email and SMS notifications from the booking monolith into a Spring Boot service, using RabbitMQ and Thymeleaf.

SIDE PROJECT
OpenAPI-diff CLI | Go
- Building a roughly 600-line command-line tool to compare OpenAPI specifications as a learning project; available on GitHub and not used in production.

CERTIFICATION
Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 11 Developer | 2020

LANGUAGES
English: Used as the working language at Tejo Insurance Tech.
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Tessel Cargo Software Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer (Python) role. I have built backend services professionally in Java and Kotlin since 2019, and I am keen to bring that experience to a Python-focused team. My Python experience so far has been scripting, not production services, but I am interested in making the move to a Python stack.

At Tejo Insurance Tech, I designed a versioned REST API used by 12 broker partners for around 400,000 quote requests per month. I have also worked directly on the reliability of event-driven services: after implementing a transactional outbox and idempotency keys for Kafka consumers, duplicate claims fell from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter. These projects have given me relevant experience with REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Kafka, automated testing and the care required when processing events reliably.

I also participate in a monthly on-call rota and handled a major Kafka lag incident in March 2024; the incident write-up was praised. I would bring that operational experience, along with hands-on use of Kubernetes on EKS, Docker, AWS S3 and SQS, to a team responsible for running its own tracking services. Tessel’s focus on dependable live shipment tracking and event streams makes this role a particularly relevant next step for my backend experience.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to the Routing & Tracking team.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
